title: Target comparison for generator pullback restrictions
statement: For schemes X,Y, f:Y→X, an arbitrary X-module M [def-pc-module-pullback] and an etale arrow i:V→W over X [def-pc-scheme], define P_U,p_U,q_U,j and K as in [lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-source-comparison]. The explicit target factor B_U(M):p_U*U*M ≅ q_U*tensorPullback(f)(M) of [lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-section] satisfies K(W*M).inv ≫ j*B_W(M).hom ≫ c(j,q_W;q_V,tensorPullback(f)(M)).hom = p_V*c(i,W;V,M).hom ≫ B_V(M). No section or invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 21.6.1, generator torsor construction; pullback/restriction of its trivializations.

proof.text: Write B_U(M) as the comparison p_U*U*M to q_U*f*M, followed by q_U* of the inverse tensor/abstract pullback comparison. Naturality of c(j,q_W;q_V) with respect to this last inverse moves that factor to q_V*. The remaining comparison identity is the associativity coherence of the module pullback pseudofunctor: both composites identify j*p_W*W*M with q_V*f*M through the same morphism to X. Use j followed by p_W equals p_V followed by i, i followed by W equals V, and j followed by q_W equals q_V. Apply the three-fold composition coherence on each path and cancel the common comparison for the total morphism. This gives K(M).inv followed by j*B_W(M) and the q comparison equal to p_V* of c(i,W;V).hom followed by B_V(M). The argument is natural for every module M, including the zero module, and does not use any section or invertibility.

theorem etaleGeneratorsPullbackTarget_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules)
    {V W : X.Etale} (i : V ⟶ W) :
    (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSquareIso f i ((pullback W.hom).obj L)).inv ≫
      (pullback ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).left).map
        (etaleGeneratorsPullbackTargetIso f W L).hom ≫ (pullbackCompOfEq
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).left
      (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom f) (Limits.pullback.snd V.hom f)
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).w ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).hom =
      (pullback (Limits.pullback.fst V.hom f)).map (pullbackCompOfEq i.left W.hom V.hom i.w
        (L)).hom ≫
        (etaleGeneratorsPullbackTargetIso f V L).hom
